title: Sections for pages
summary: Whole page sections (heroes, pricing, FAQs, sign-in) built from the same tokens, so a page can be assembled in minutes and still look designed.

components.name: Hero, split
components.summary: Headline, one line of explanation and one primary action on the left; the product on the right.
called: top section of a landing page with a screenshot
first screen of a SaaS site

anatomy.name: Headline
anatomy.text: What it does, under 12 words.

anatomy.name: Primary action
anatomy.text: One filled button; the second is ghost.

anatomy.name: Reassurance
anatomy.text: Removes the main worry in one line.

anatomy.name: Product
anatomy.text: The real product, not stock art.

components.prompt: Build a split hero: left column with a short eyebrow, a headline under 12 words, a one-sentence lede, one primary button plus a ghost secondary, and a reassurance line with two checks; right column shows the product in a framed card. Stack on narrow containers. Tokens only.
components.debug: Debug my hero. Rule out: two primary buttons; a headline over two lines on desktop; illustration instead of product; text over a busy image with low contrast. The symptom:

components.name: Hero, centred
components.summary: A centred headline with an announcement pill, two actions and a framed product shot below.
called: big centred headline with a little new badge above
centred landing header with screenshot below

anatomy.name: Announcement
anatomy.text: One recent thing, linked.

anatomy.name: Headline
anatomy.text: Short lines read better centred.

anatomy.name: Product shot
anatomy.text: Framed, lifted with one soft shadow.

components.prompt: Build a centred hero: an announcement pill ("New" chip + text + arrow) linking to the changelog, a headline capped at 16ch, a lede, a primary and a secondary button, then a framed product shot. Keep text centred only because every line is short.
components.debug: Debug my centred hero. Rule out: centred paragraphs longer than three lines; a pill nobody can click; the product shot cropped on mobile; gradient headline text. The symptom:

components.name: Feature grid
components.summary: Six features in three columns: a quiet icon, a short title and one sentence each.

anatomy.name: Icon tile
anatomy.text: One icon style, one accent; never emoji.

anatomy.name: Title
anatomy.text: Three to five words.

anatomy.name: Sentence
anatomy.text: One sentence with a concrete detail.

components.prompt: Build a feature grid: eyebrow and a two-line heading, then six features in three columns (two, then one on narrow containers), each with a 36px outlined icon tile, a short title and one concrete sentence. No cards, no shadows: whitespace does the grouping.
components.debug: Debug my feature grid. Rule out: emoji icons; every feature in its own heavy card; paragraphs instead of one sentence; uneven icon styles. The symptom:

components.name: Pricing tiers
components.summary: Three plans side by side; the middle one is outlined in the accent and is the only filled button.
called: three pricing cards with the middle one highlighted

anatomy.name: Featured plan
anatomy.text: Accent outline and badge; one per page.

anatomy.name: Price
anatomy.text: Large, with the unit in plain words beside it.

anatomy.name: What you get
anatomy.text: Short lines, the difference first.

components.prompt: Build pricing tiers: a centred heading and one-line lede, then three plan cards (name, who it is for, price with "per seat / month", a full-width button, then a hairline and a tick list). Feature the middle plan with an accent outline, a "Most popular" badge and the only primary button. Stack to one column under 760px.
components.debug: Debug my pricing cards. Rule out: three primary buttons; prices that jump width when toggled; feature lists of different lengths pushing buttons out of line; a featured plan that is just a different colour with no label. The symptom:

components.name: Testimonial grid
components.summary: Three short customer quotes with a name and role, aligned so the names sit on one line.

anatomy.name: Quote
anatomy.text: One specific outcome, under 30 words.

anatomy.name: Attribution
anatomy.text: Name and role; pinned to the bottom so all three line up.

components.prompt: Build a testimonial grid: eyebrow and heading, then three quote cards in a row (stacked when narrow), each a <figure> with a short <blockquote> about a concrete outcome and a <figcaption> with an initials avatar, name and role pinned to the bottom so names align. No star ratings, no carousels.
components.debug: Debug my testimonials. Rule out: quotes so long they become paragraphs; names at different heights; star ratings on B2B quotes; a carousel hiding two of the three. The symptom:

components.name: FAQ section
components.summary: Heading on the left, questions on the right as native details that open with a rotating plus.
called: questions section on a pricing page

anatomy.name: Question
anatomy.text: The question as people would ask it.

anatomy.name: Plus
anatomy.text: Turns into a cross when open.

anatomy.name: Way out
anatomy.text: Where to ask anything not listed.

components.prompt: Build an FAQ section: two columns (heading with a "write to us" line on the left, questions on the right), each question a native <details>/<summary> with hairline dividers and a plus that rotates to a cross; first one open; stacks under 760px; no JavaScript.
components.debug: Debug my FAQ. Rule out: a JS accordion where native <details> would do; the default disclosure triangle showing next to your icon; answers longer than four lines; questions nobody asks. The symptom:

components.name: Call-to-action band
components.summary: A calm closing panel with one sentence and one primary action, tinted with a single soft accent glow.
called: sign up box at the bottom of the page
get started section before the footer

anatomy.name: Promise
anatomy.text: What they get and how fast.

anatomy.name: Primary action
anatomy.text: The same action as the hero.

anatomy.name: Panel
anatomy.text: One soft accent glow from a corner, single hue.

components.prompt: Build a closing CTA band before the footer: a rounded panel with a single-hue accent glow from the top-right corner, a two-line promise heading, a short reassurance line, and the same primary action as the hero plus a ghost alternative; wraps to stacked on narrow screens.
components.debug: Debug my CTA band. Rule out: a purple-to-blue gradient background; a different primary action than the hero; three buttons; white text on a light tint. The symptom:

components.name: Stats band
components.summary: Four large figures with plain labels, divided by hairlines instead of boxes.
called: row of big numbers on a landing page

anatomy.name: Figure
anatomy.text: Large display type; units written out.

anatomy.name: Label
anatomy.text: Says what the number counts and over what period.

anatomy.name: Divider
anatomy.text: Hairlines group the figures; no cards.

components.prompt: Build a stats band: a small eyebrow heading, then a <dl> of four figures in a row (two by two when narrow), each a large display-type value above a plain label that says what was counted and over what period, divided by hairlines, no boxes or icons.
components.debug: Debug my stats band. Rule out: rounded vanity numbers with no period ("10k+ users"); icons on every figure; numbers that jump width when counting up; boxes around each stat. The symptom:

components.name: Newsletter signup
components.summary: One-line email form that validates on submit, explains errors and confirms in place.
called: enter your email to get updates

anatomy.name: Email field
anatomy.text: Hidden label, real type, browser autofill.

anatomy.name: Message
anatomy.text: Reassurance, then the error or the confirmation, in the same spot.

components.prompt: Build a newsletter section: a short promise on the left ("One email a month") and an email field with a Subscribe button on the right; validate on submit only, explain errors in words with an example, confirm in place ("Check you@… for a link"), and keep a "No spam" line under the field.
components.debug: Debug my signup form. Rule out: errors shown while the user is still typing; a placeholder as the only label; success shown as a toast that disappears; no autocomplete="email". The symptom:

components.name: How it works
components.summary: Three numbered steps on one thin connecting line, turning vertical on narrow screens.
called: three steps with numbers in circles

anatomy.name: Step number
anatomy.text: The list is ordered, so the numbers are real.

anatomy.name: Connector
anatomy.text: One hairline links the steps; vertical when stacked.

anatomy.name: Detail
anatomy.text: One sentence with the concrete action.

components.prompt: Build a "How it works" section: eyebrow and heading, then an <ol> of three steps each with a 35px numbered circle, a short title and one sentence, joined by a single hairline behind the circles; the line and list turn vertical under 760px. First step circle in the accent.
components.debug: Debug my steps section. Rule out: numbers as decorative divs in an unordered list; the connector line drawn through the text on mobile; more than four steps; icons and numbers competing. The symptom:

components.name: Team grid
components.summary: Square portraits or initials with a name and role, in a grid that fills any width.
called: grid of people photos with names

anatomy.name: Portrait
anatomy.text: Same crop for everyone; initials when there is no photo.

anatomy.name: Name and role
anatomy.text: Two short lines, nothing else.

components.prompt: Build a team section: heading and a one-line lede with a hiring link, then a grid (auto-fill, min 140px) of square portraits with rounded corners, falling back to large initials on a neutral tile, each with name and role underneath.
components.debug: Debug my team grid. Rule out: photos of different crops and sizes; social icons on every person; bios that make the grid uneven; images without width and height causing layout shift. The symptom:

components.name: Sign-in card
components.summary: A centred card with SSO buttons, an "or" divider and a passwordless email link.
called: login box in the middle of the page
sign in with google or email

anatomy.name: Providers
anatomy.text: Secondary buttons; the email path is the one primary.

anatomy.name: Divider
anatomy.text: "or" between two hairlines.

anatomy.name: Email
anatomy.text: Visible label, real type, autofill.

anatomy.name: Result
anatomy.text: "Check your inbox" in place, no page change.

components.prompt: Build a passwordless sign-in card: a small mark, "Sign in to <product>", one line of welcome, SSO provider buttons (secondary), an "or" divider, a labelled work-email field and one primary "Email me a sign-in link" button; validate on submit, confirm in place, and link to sign-up at the bottom.
components.debug: Debug my sign-in card. Rule out: provider buttons styled as primary alongside the main button; no visible label on the email field; errors that blame the user vaguely ("Invalid input"); autocomplete turned off. The symptom:

components.name: Not found (404)
components.summary: A calm error page: what happened in plain words, a search box and four ways out.

anatomy.name: Code
anatomy.text: Small and mono; the words matter more.

anatomy.name: What happened
anatomy.text: No jokes, no blame.

anatomy.name: Search
anatomy.text: The fastest way to what they wanted.

anatomy.name: Ways out
anatomy.text: Home, docs, status, a person.

components.prompt: Build a 404 page: a small mono "404", a plain heading ("This page moved or never existed"), one line suggesting what to do, a rounded search field and four quiet links (Home, Docs, Status, Contact support). Centred, no illustration, no jokes.
components.debug: Debug my error page. Rule out: a giant illustration pushing the way out below the fold; a joke heading that hides what happened; no search; links styled as primary buttons. The symptom:

components.name: Integrations grid
components.summary: One linked tile per tool with a two-letter mark, its name and what it is for.
called: grid of apps it connects to

anatomy.name: Mark
anatomy.text: Monogram placeholder; swap for the real logo in mono.

anatomy.name: Name and use
anatomy.text: "Postgres · Database": what it is and why.

anatomy.name: Link cue
anatomy.text: The whole tile is one link.

components.prompt: Build an integrations section: eyebrow, heading and a lede with a "see all" link, then a 4-column grid (2, then 1 when narrow) of whole-tile links each with a 36px monochrome mark, the tool name, a one-word purpose and an arrow; tiles lift 1px on hover.
components.debug: Debug my integrations grid. Rule out: full-colour logos shouting over the page; tiles that are not links; mixed logo sizes; dozens of tiles with no search. The symptom:

components.name: Contact section
components.summary: Ways to reach you on the left, a four-field form on the right that validates on submit.
called: contact us page with a form

anatomy.name: Other ways
anatomy.text: Email, status page, office: not everything needs the form.

anatomy.name: Topic
anatomy.text: Routes the message without free-text guessing.

anatomy.name: Result
anatomy.text: Lists what is missing, then confirms.

components.prompt: Build a contact section: left column with eyebrow, heading, reply-time promise and a description list (email, status page, office); right column a card form with name and work email side by side, a topic select, a message textarea and one primary button; validate on submit, mark invalid fields, list what is missing, confirm in place.
components.debug: Debug my contact form. Rule out: placeholder-only labels; validation on every keystroke; a CAPTCHA before anything is typed; no confirmation of what happens next. The symptom:

components.name: Blog grid
components.summary: Three latest posts with an image, kind, date and title; the whole card is one link.

anatomy.name: Kind
anatomy.text: Guide, Engineering, Customers: one word.

anatomy.name: Title link
anatomy.text: One link per card, stretched over it.

anatomy.name: All posts
anatomy.text: Top-right, quiet.

components.prompt: Build a "From the blog" section: heading with an "All posts →" link on the right, then three post cards (16:10 image, kind in accent ink and date, a balanced two-line title, read time); the title link is stretched over the whole card so there is one link per card.
components.debug: Debug my blog grid. Rule out: several links per card (image, title, read more) for the same URL; titles over three lines; images of mixed ratios; dates without a year on old posts. The symptom:

components.name: Feature rows, alternating
components.summary: Text and a product picture side by side, swapping sides each row, with two ticked details.
called: features with pictures alternating left and right

anatomy.name: Claim
anatomy.text: What it does, as a short sentence.

anatomy.name: Details
anatomy.text: Two concrete facts with ticks.

anatomy.name: Picture
anatomy.text: Swaps sides each row; stacks under the text on phones.

components.prompt: Build alternating feature rows: each row is text (eyebrow, display heading, one paragraph under 48ch, two ticked details) beside a framed product picture; odd rows swap sides using order, and everything stacks text-first under 760px. Keep 64px between rows.
components.debug: Debug my feature rows. Rule out: pictures before text on mobile; stock illustrations instead of product; rows of different heights that feel random; more than three rows in a row. The symptom:

components.name: Logo cloud
components.summary: One muted line, then six customer logos in an even grid, all in one ink.
called: row of company logos under the hero

anatomy.name: Lead line
anatomy.text: Says who, not "trusted by thousands".

anatomy.name: Logo
anatomy.text: One ink, equal visual weight, no colour logos.

components.prompt: Add a logo cloud under the hero: one muted line ("Used by finance and data teams at") and six customer logos in an even 6-column grid (3×2 when narrow), all monochrome at the same visual weight.
components.debug: Debug my logo cloud. Rule out: full-colour logos fighting the hero; logos of wildly different sizes; more than two rows; logos without permission. The symptom:

components.name: Article layout
components.summary: One comfortable reading column with a pull quote, and a sticky "On this page" list beside it.
called: article with table of contents on the side
docs page with on this page

anatomy.name: Measure
anatomy.text: Lines short enough to read comfortably.

anatomy.name: Pull quote
anatomy.text: One per article, in the display face.

anatomy.name: On this page
anatomy.text: Follows you down; links to every heading.

components.prompt: Build an article layout: a reading column capped at --measure (68ch) with eyebrow, big title, a larger lede, h3 sections with scroll-margin-top, body at 1.7 line-height and one accent-ruled pull quote; beside it a 200px sticky "On this page" list on a hairline rail. Under 760px the list moves above the article.
components.debug: Debug my article layout. Rule out: lines longer than 80 characters; headings hidden under a sticky header when linked; a TOC that does not scroll with the page; body text below 16px. The symptom:

components.name: Before and after
components.summary: The old way, muted, beside the new way, outlined in the accent: three concrete lines each.
called: old way vs new way boxes

anatomy.name: Before
anatomy.text: Muted surface and crosses; specific pains.

anatomy.name: After
anatomy.text: Accent outline and ticks; each line answers the one opposite.

components.prompt: Add a before/after section: a centred heading, then two columns; "Before" on a muted surface with three specific pains marked with crosses, "With <product>" outlined in the accent with three matching outcomes marked with green ticks. Each line on the right answers the line on the left.
components.debug: Debug my before/after. Rule out: vague pains ("inefficient workflows"); lines that do not pair up; red and green as the only difference; competitors named in a way you cannot back up. The symptom:

components.name: Project grid
components.summary: A portfolio work grid: large 4:3 plates in two or three columns with the project name, type, place and year.

anatomy.name: Plate
anatomy.text: Holds an ; without one, a numbered plate.

anatomy.name: Project
anatomy.text: The name; the whole card is one link.

anatomy.name: Year
anatomy.text: Right-aligned on the title line.

components.prompt: Build a "Selected work" section for a portfolio: an eyebrow and heading, then a two-column grid of project cards (three with data-cols="3"). Each card is one link with a 4:3 media plate holding the project photo, then the project name with the year right-aligned and a line for type and place. With no photo the plate shows a large two-digit index and the project type, in the same style for every card. One column on narrow containers.
components.debug: Debug my project grid. Rule out: plates of mixed ratios; some cards with art and some blank; several links per card; titles longer than two lines; hover effects that scale the image past its frame. The symptom:
